subject: Close sequencing and procurement timeline for MSA/DPA/order form
messages:
From: Allison Park <allison@heliomed.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com; jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com; Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@heliomed.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close sequencing and procurement timeline for MSA/DPA/order form

Laura / team,

Thanks for the rundown on the pilot. A few constraints from procurement and legal I need to call out that will affect sequencing:
• Our finance team requires an executed order form (signed by vendor and HelioMed PO or internal acceptance) before a PO is issued. That usually happens after MSA signature.
• GC will run a DPA review (Tom Reyes is on copy). Typical turnaround is 3–7 business days but can go longer if we have redlines.
• We need SOC 2 evidence and a vendor security questionnaire filled out before final acceptance.

Attached is a short note outlining procurement constraints and the internal blackout week for PO processing (first week of Sep). If you can provide a MAP with owners and dates we can try to parallelize reviews where possible.

Allison
Director, Procurement
HelioMed

Attachments: HelioMed_Procurement_Constraints.pdf; SOC2_snapshot_request_form.xlsx (referenced)
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Allison Park <allison@heliomed.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close sequencing and procurement timeline for MSA/DPA/order form

Allison — thanks for the clear constraints. We can absolutely work around the PO blackout if we stage the close and get signature sequencing defined. Proposed approach:

1) Parallel track: send MSA + Order Form via DocuSign for signature now. We can attach a draft order form that references the PO to come, and include invoice schedule / T&Cs so finance can pre-review.
2) DPA redline: Karthik will circulate a marked-up DPA to Tom for GC review. If HelioMed prefers, we can accept a standard DPA + addendum to speed signature and close the order form, then finish DPA redlines as an addendum.
3) Security evidence: we will attach SOC 2 snapshot and a short security packet to the DocuSign email so GC/procurement have what they need to accept.

I put together a short MAP below with owners and suggested target dates (I’ll upload a CSV). If that looks OK to you we’ll kick the DocuSign envelope this afternoon.

Mutual Action Plan (proposed)
- Redwood: Send DocuSign for MSA + Order Form (with preliminary invoice schedule) — owner: laura_bennett — target: 2028-09-03
- HelioMed: GC initial review of DPA — owner: Tom Reyes — target: 2028-09-06
- Redwood: Provide SOC 2 snapshot + questionnaire answers — owner: jonas_weber — target: 2028-09-03
- HelioMed: Issue PO / internal acceptance (after order form) — owner: procurement@heliomed.com — target: 2028-09-10 (adjusted if blackout)

I’m attaching our draft DPA with a few minor clarifications Karthik recommends. Happy to take the path of signing MSA+Order Form first if that helps with onboarding.

Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_markedup.docx; SOC2_snapshot_2028.pdf
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com; jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Allison Park <allison@heliomed.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close sequencing and procurement timeline for MSA/DPA/order form

Laura / team — quick note on the DPA and sequencing from legal side:

- High priority items I want to call out for HelioMed GC: data retention limits (Section 4), subprocessors list and 30-day notification window (Section 6), and the security incident SLA (Section 9). None of these are deal stoppers, but Tom may request small edits.
- Proposed playbook: get MSA + Order Form executed first to establish commercial terms; execute a standard DPA (we can provide an addendum if HelioMed insists on alternative residency language). This keeps billing and onboarding moving while we finish the DPA.
- If GC insists on changes that affect liability or indemnity, escalate to commercial. We should set an internal cut-off: if substantive redlines arrive by 2028-09-07 we will pause provisioning until the liability items are approved.

Action items (internal):
1) Karthik: circulate highlighted DPA + change summary to Tom — target 2028-08-31 (done).
2) Jonas: prepare SOC 2 snapshot + answers to procurement questionnaire — target 2028-09-03.
3) Laura: send DocuSign for MSA + Order Form (with invoice cadence) — target 2028-09-03.
4) All: if HelioMed requests changes to liability or indemnity, escalate to sales leadership for approval — cut-off 2028-09-07.

I’ve attached the redlined DPA for quick review. I agree that signing MSA + Order Form while DPA review runs in parallel is the lowest-friction path so long as we have the cut-off and escalation defined.

— Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_markedup.docx
From: Allison Park <allison@heliomed.com>

Cc: procurement@heliomed.com; Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@heliomed.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Sep 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close sequencing and procurement timeline for MSA/DPA/order form

Laura — quick update from our side after internal sync:
• GC (Tom) will start the DPA review and expects to have initial comments by 2028-09-06.
• Procurement confirmed finance blackout week is 2028-09-04 through 2028-09-08; they will not process new POs during that window.
• Given the blackout, we can sign an order form and have the PO issued in the week of 2028-09-10, provided the order form is fully executed and invoice cadence is agreed.

One ask: can Redwood provide a short provisional start clause (30 days) we can include in the order form that allows us to commence integration work pending PO issuance? That would let us start work the week of 2028-09-10 even if PO is formally created slightly later. I’m attaching our PO template for your finance team.

Allison

Finalized MAP (targets)

- 2028-09-03: Redwood provide SOC2 snapshot + questionnaire responses (owner: jonas_weber) — attached SOC2_snapshot_2028.pdf
- 2028-09-06: HelioMed GC initial DPA comments (owner: Tom Reyes)
- 2028-09-10: Procurement issue PO post-blackout (owner: procurement@heliomed.com)
- 2028-09-10: Target provisioning / integration kickoff under provisional start clause (owner: HelioMed + Redwood)
